scope: Saved local metadata, CSVs and scripts only. No model reruns, source GPS validation, remote access or literature review.

full_hourly_export.row_definition: one animal in one hourly window

nightly_export.row_definition: one animal in one biological night
nightly_export.night_definition_utc: 16:00 through 06:00 inclusive; night_date is the evening date
nightly_export.classification_rule: Dominant hourly assigned_social_unit defines immediate nightly membership; dominant dynamic_social_unit is retained as the conservative longer-term membership.

two_metre_merge_summary.interpretation: negative observed-minus-shuffle means fewer 2 m cross-group links than expected from group composition

copper_lilac.fusion_context: canonical between-group shared/fusion hours for the Copper-Lilac dynamic-unit pair
copper_lilac.pair_opportunity: both animals have valid GPS positions in the same 2-minute bin and canonical fusion cluster
copper_lilac.pair_contact_rate: contact bins within the selected radius / pairwise co-observed bins
copper_lilac.aggregation: pair rates averaged within individual, individuals averaged equally within original group, original groups averaged equally
copper_lilac.within_reference: equal mean of within-Copper and within-Lilac individual-average pair rates
copper_lilac.integration_ratio: group-balanced cross-origin rate / within-reference rate; 1 means equal cross- and within-origin contact density
copper_lilac.bootstrap_unit: individual, resampled separately within original group and month
copper_lilac.caution: Inference is limited to tracked animals and canonical fusion hours; uncollared contacts are not recoverable.
